text: dsh-session-cost 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的会话花费与账户余额显示插件。它在服务端提供 /session-cost 路由，在浏览器 composer dock 中增加一行读数。插件读取会话 token 用量和最新助手消息的模型信息，按官方价格估算输入、缓存读取与输出费用，并查询 DeepSeek 账户余额。价格表会定期从官方页面获取，悬停可查看费用拆分、余额赠送与充值部分及价格状态。适合希望在 DSH Web 会话中同时查看用量成本和余额的 DeepSeek 用户；需要配置 DeepSeek API Key。

dsh-session-cost adds estimated spending and DeepSeek balance to the DSH Web composer dock. It reads token usage and the latest assistant model, applies official prices, and refreshes balance and pricing data. Hover for cost and balance details. A DeepSeek API key is required.

希望在一个地方同时对照余额和当前会话花费
How can I see an estimate of token spending beside my DSH Web conversation?
Show my DeepSeek balance and the current session cost in the composer area.
dsh-session-cost 的功能「账户余额」：查询 DeepSeek 官方余额接口，并在 DSH Web 会话栏显示余额与赠送、充值拆分。页面每分钟刷新展示，服务端按配置缓存查询结果。
dsh-session-cost 的功能「会话费用估算」：读取当前会话 token 用量，按输入、缓存读取、缓存写入和输出价格计算估算花费，并在悬浮详情中展示组成。
dsh-session-cost 的功能「按模型计价」：从最新助手消息的 provenance 读取模型标识，选择 flash 或 pro 价格桶，再用于当前会话费用估算。
dsh-session-cost 的功能「同步官方价格」：定期获取并解析 DeepSeek 官方价格页，按模型提供当前价格；价格页不可用时使用内置价目继续返回价格快照。
@ljcscp/dsh-session-cost README · dsh-session-cost：DeepSeek account balance and session-cost readout for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web GUI.

@ljcscp/dsh-session-cost README · dsh-session-cost：- **Account balance** — queries the official `GET /user/balance` endpoint (the API key stays on the host, resolved per refresh through the DSH credentials seam)
- **Session spend** — token usage × **official DeepSeek prices**, auto-fetched from the [official pricing page](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/) every 6h, so price changes never require a plugin update
- **Peak/off-peak pricing** — the 2026-08-17 rollout is applied automatically: peak hours 09:00-12:00 / 14:00-18:00 (Beijing), off-peak at half price
- **Per-model costing** — the session's actual model (deepseek-v4-flash / deepseek-v4-pro) is read from the newest assistant message's provenance and priced at its own bucket

@ljcscp/dsh-session-cost README · dsh-session-cost：The composer dock shows one readout under the shipped stats line:

```
本会话 ¥0.90 · 余额 ¥30.82
```

Hover for the breakdown (input / cache read / output, model, pricing source) and the balance split (granted + topped up).

@ljcscp/dsh-session-cost README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.5` or newer (web profile)
- A DeepSeek API key stored through the DSH credentials seam (`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` — the web Models page writes it)

@ljcscp/dsh-session-cost README · Installation：From a git URL (no npm account needed):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ljcscp/dsh-session-cost
```

From npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @ljcscp/dsh-session-cost
```

From a local checkout (development):

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ljcscp/dsh-session-cost.git
dsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/dsh-session-cost
```

Restart `dsh web`, then refresh the page. The readout appears in the composer dock below the conversation stats line.

@ljcscp/dsh-session-cost README · Configuration：| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `refreshMs` | `number` | `60000` | Balance cache lifetime in ms (failures retry after 10s) |
| `pricingRefreshHours` | `number` | `6` | Hours between official-pricing page refreshes |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `string` | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | Credential ref storing the DeepSeek API key |
| `baseURL` | `string` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | Endpoint base; `/user/balance` is appended |
| `trustedHosts` | `string[]` | `[]` | Non-loopback authorities served beyond the trust fence |

@ljcscp/dsh-session-cost README · How it works：- **Host half** (`src/index.ts`): registers one trusted webserver route `/session-cost` that serves the balance snapshot (cached `refreshMs`) and the effective pricing snapshot (official page parsed per `pricingRefreshHours`, peak/off-peak band applied by the current Beijing hour once the rollout is live). The API key never leaves the host.
- **Browser half** (`src/client/`): a `conversation.composer.dock` entry that reads the `tokenUsage` projection, detects the session's model from the newest assistant provenance, applies the effective bucket, and renders the readout — refreshed every minute.

@ljcscp/dsh-session-cost README · How it works：Cost formula (matches the official billing rule `扣减费用 = token 消耗量 × 模型单价`):

```
spend = uncachedInput × inputPerMillion + cacheRead × cacheReadPerMillion + output × outputPerMillion   (per 1M tokens)
```

Cache writes bill at the uncached input rate (DeepSeek reports only hit/miss buckets). The readout is an estimate at official rates; the official bill on platform.deepseek.com/usage lags by a few minutes of settlement.
